content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Dry bulk ship owner carrying coal and grain; the target runs LPG gas carriers, a different vessel type and cargo."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Truckload freight hauling on US roads; no seaborne gas shipping or vessel chartering overlap with the target."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Intermodal and truckload freight brokerage for shippers; different transport mode and customers from LPG gas shipping."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Onshore gas gathering, processing and pipelines in the Permian; no seaborne gas carrier operations like the target."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Rents and fabricates natural gas compressors for producers; does not own or charter ships carrying LPG."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Dry bulk vessel operator carrying grains and ores; different cargo and vessel class from very large gas carriers."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Oil refiner selling gasoline and fuels with retail stations; the target sells seaborne shipping capacity, not refined products."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Finished-vehicle transport by truck for automakers; different cargo, mode and customers from seaborne LPG transport."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Less-than-truckload freight trucking across North America; no shipping of gases or vessel chartering like the target."}]}
